s: John on Patmos sees the risen Christ among seven golden lampstands: I am the Alpha and the Omega.
Messages to the churches of Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum and Thyatira.
Messages to Sardis, Philadelphia and Laodicea: behold, I stand at the door and knock.
John sees the throne of God in heaven, surrounded by worship.
The Lamb that was slain is worthy to open the sealed scroll.
The Lamb opens the first six seals: horsemen, martyrs and a great earthquake.
God's servants are sealed. A great multitude from every nation stands before the Lamb.
The seventh seal is opened, and the first trumpets sound.
The fifth and sixth trumpets bring locusts and armies.
An angel gives John a small scroll to eat.
Two witnesses prophesy and are killed and raised. The seventh trumpet sounds.
A woman clothed with the sun gives birth to a son, and a dragon attacks her. Michael casts the dragon out of heaven.
A beast rises from the sea and another from the earth; its number is 666.
The Lamb on Mount Zion with the redeemed. The harvest of the earth.
The seven angels with the last plagues.
The seven bowls of God's wrath are poured out.
Babylon the great harlot sits on the beast.
Babylon the great has fallen.
The wedding supper of the Lamb. Christ rides out as the faithful and true Word of God.
Satan is bound for a thousand years, then defeated. The dead are judged.
A new heaven and a new earth. God will wipe away every tear. The holy city, the new Jerusalem.
The river of life flows from the throne. Come, Lord Jesus.

21: At the end of the Bible, God makes everything new. There will be no more death, mourning or pain, and God will dwell with his people for ever.
